verdict.rationale: Vanta's SOC 2 product page and related docs describe automated Trust Services testing, evidence collection, policy drafting via AI Agent, audit collaboration, and cross-mapping across pre-built frameworks — directly matching an end-to-end SOC 2 Type I/II program. Missing for 10: explicit documentation distinguishing Type I vs Type II workflows, explicit Trust Services Criteria mapping detail, and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor marketing pages.
